skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop and apply research methodologies effectively.
Analyze and solve complex economic problems critically.
Plan and manage a research project from conception to completion.
Apply economic theories to real-world scenarios.
Produce well-structured and coherent academic papers.
Collect, process, and interpret data for research purposes.
Effectively present research findings to an audience.

prerequisite_courses: Core knowledge courses in economics and real estate
